answer: In an agent labor market, each identity must reserve one named ledge for a 90-minute shift, consume one cedar stake from a single-use mill lot, and fit one sparrow nest box whose tag the shift lead scans to that key. Example: 10 fakes need 10 shifts, 10 stakes, and 10 boxes. One worker cannot cover two bays at once, so a reused stake serial or a missing box fails the scan check.
